newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA COTTON STEADY DESPITE SLUGGISH MILL BUYING.
newsitem.headline: INDIA COTTON STEADY DESPITE SLUGGISH MILL BUYING.

text.p: Cotton prices were steady at the improved level on the local market on Thursday despite sluggish mill buying at the higher level, offset by a shortage of ready stock, dealers said.
"The undercurrent was firm on expectations that the Indian government may allow fresh export of cotton by state-owned agencies," one broker said.
In spot deals Bengal-deshi was steady at 1,125/1,160 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) as was Punjab saw-ginned at 1,825/1,900 rupees per maund and F-414 at 2,080/2,100 rupees per maund.
In the Gujarat segment Kalyan cotton consolidated gains at 14,500/15,100 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) as did Kala-ginned at 12,700 rupees and Wagad cotton at 13,500 rupees per candy.
The Bombay cotton market will be closed on Friday for Independence Day and on Monday for the Coconut Day festival.
